column3: ## Create articles with multiple affiliations through the API
Setup: Open /testdrive/multiple_affiliations in its own tab and keep it open (see the first test in this testset)
Setup: You need a tool that can send a POST request with a JSON body, eg curl, Postman, or the API docs page /api/docs
Send a POST request to the "api_create_article" link with header "Content-Type: application/json" and the "api_json_affiliations_list" value as the body

column4: The response status is 201 and the response contains the new article's id
"Api Author" is listed once with "Uni One" and "Uni Two" on separate lines

column3: Send a GET request to /api/articles/<the returned id>?api_key=<testdrive publisher api_key>

column4: The author in bibjson.author has an "affiliations" list: ["Uni One", "Uni Two"]

column3: Send another POST request in the same way, with the "api_json_legacy_affiliation" value as the body. It uses the old single "affiliation" string field.

column4: The response status is 201 - the old field is still accepted

column3: Send a GET request for the second article's id

column4: The author has "affiliations": ["Old Style University"], converted from the old field
